Rpackage RamanMP

2022-12-16

library(dplyr)
library(reshape)
library(reshape2)
library(RamanMP)
library(glmnet)
library(cvms)
library(ggplot2)
source("./interpolation_function.R")

Data

Trainning

x <- data_slopp_norm_pivot_w[,-c(1,2,3,4,length(data_slopp_norm_pivot_w))]
x <- x[as.character(data_slopp_norm_pivot_w$polymer) %in% slopp_polymer_dict$polymer,]

y <- merge(data.frame(polymer=data_slopp_norm_pivot_w$polymer), 
           slopp_polymer_dict, by="polymer")$class

y_polymer <- merge(data.frame(polymer=data_slopp_norm_pivot_w$polymer), 
           slopp_polymer_dict, by="polymer")$polymer

set.seed(246753)
train = sample(length(y), size = length(y) *0.8, replace = F)
x_train = x[train,]
x_mat_train = as.matrix(x_train)
y_train = y[train]
data_train = data.frame(polymer=y_train, x_train)
data_train$polymer = as.factor(data_train$polymer)

x_mat_tets <- as.matrix(x[-train,])
y_test = y[-train]

cvfit <- cv.glmnet(x=x_mat_train, y=y_train, family = "multinomial", type.multinomial = "grouped", lambda = exp(seq(-8,-1, length.out=100)))
plot(cvfit)

Test error Slopp

y_pred = predict(cvfit, newx = x_mat_tets, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")
y_pred = as.numeric(y_pred)

y_pred_pol = merge(data.frame(class=y_pred), 
      slopp_polymer_dict, by="class")$polymer

print('test error within Slopp data:')
## [1] "test error within Slopp data:"
mean(y_test == y_pred)
## [1] 0.8666667

Confusion Matrix Slopp

conf_mat <- confusion_matrix(targets = as.character(y_polymer[-train]),
                             predictions = y_pred_pol)

plot_confusion_matrix(conf_mat$`Confusion Matrix`[[1]], 
                      rotate_y_text = F, 
                      font_counts = font(size = 1),
                      font_normalized = font(size = 2),
                      font_row_percentages = font(size = 1),
                      font_col_percentages = font(size = 1)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

Error RamanMP data

x_mat_tets <- as.matrix(MPdatabase_inter_norm_pivot_w_polymers[,-c(1,2,3,1402)])
y_test <- as.character(MPdatabase_inter_norm_pivot_w_polymers[, 2])

y_test_2 = left_join(data.frame(polymer=as.character(y_test)), 
                     slopp_polymer_dict, by="polymer")$class

y_pred = predict(cvfit, newx = x_mat_tets, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")
y_pred = as.numeric(y_pred)
y_pred_pol = merge(data.frame(class=y_pred), 
                   slopp_polymer_dict, by="class")$polymer

print('error for RamanMP data:')
## [1] "error for RamanMP data:"
mean(y_test_2 == y_pred, na.rm=T)
## [1] 0.96

Confusion Matrix RamanMP

conf_mat <- confusion_matrix(targets = y_test,
                             predictions = y_pred_pol)

plot_confusion_matrix(conf_mat$`Confusion Matrix`[[1]], 
                      rotate_y_text = F, 
                      font_counts = font(size = 1),
                      font_normalized = font(size = 2),
                      font_row_percentages = font(size = 1),
                      font_col_percentages = font(size = 1)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

Comparison with correlation matching

Correlation matching error

y_pred_prob <- predict(cvfit, newx = x_mat_tets, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
y_pred_prob <- apply(y_pred_prob, MARGIN=1, FUN=max)

table(y_test_2, as.numeric(y_pred))
##         
## y_test_2 2 5 6 8 9 11 12 14
##       2  1 0 0 0 0  0  0  0
##       5  0 1 0 1 0  0  0  0
##       6  0 0 1 0 0  0  0  0
##       8  0 0 0 5 0  0  0  0
##       9  0 0 0 0 6  0  0  0
##       11 0 0 0 0 0  5  0  0
##       12 0 0 0 0 0  0  2  0
##       14 0 0 0 0 0  0  0  3
identif_spectra_polymer <- c()
identif_spectra_corr <- c()
i = 1


if(!file.exists("correlation_matching.rds")) {
  for (fn in MPdatabase_inter_norm_pivot_w_polymers$file_name) {
    identif_spectra <- spectra.corr(data_slopp_pivot, MPdatabase[, c('freq',fn)], t=0.5, normal='SNV')
    identif_spectra_polymer[i] = rownames(identif_spectra)[1]
    identif_spectra_corr[i] = identif_spectra[1]
    i = i + 1
}


corr_table <- left_join(data.frame(file_name_2=identif_spectra_polymer,
                     corr=identif_spectra_corr,
                     y_test),
          as.data.frame(data_slopp %>% 
                          select(file_name_2, polymer) %>% 
                          group_by(file_name_2, polymer) %>% 
                          summarise(n=n())), by='file_name_2') %>%
  select(polymer, y_test, corr) %>%
  mutate(comparision=(polymer == y_test)*1)
  saveRDS(corr_table, "correlation_matching.rds")
} else
  {
  corr_table = readRDS(file = "correlation_matching.rds")
}

mean(corr_table$comparision)
## [1] 0.862069
